title: Jovial Creamy Irish Potato Casserole
description: A fermented, creamy, and cozy Irish dish featuring kosher salt and a sweet glaze, perfect for a plant-based friendly meal. This casserole is made with tender potatoes and a rich cashew cream.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and kosher salt, tossing to coat.
In a blender or food processor, combine the soaked cashews, nutritional yeast, lemon juice, and 1/4 cup of water, blending until smooth and creamy.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the olive oil, maple syrup, and apple cider vinegar to make the glaze.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes, followed by a layer of the cashew cream, and then a drizzle of the glaze.
Repeat the layering process until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of potatoes on top.
Drizzle the remaining glaze over the top layer of potatoes.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
